name: Análisis FACS
description: Utiliza el Sistema de Codificación de Acción Facial para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis FACS Action Unit Analysis
mechanism:
This method performs Facial Action Coding System (FACS) analysis for deepfake detection following Ekman & Friesen's framework:

1. **Integral AU Detección**: All 30+ FACS action units are detected per frame with intensity ratings (A-E). This includes upper face AUs (AU1-7), lower face AUs (AU9-28), and miscellaneous AUs (AU38, AU39, AU43, AU45, AU46). Each AU is tracked with its activation intensity over time.

2. **AU Combination Validity**: The detected AU combination per frame is checked against the FACS combinatorial rules. Certain AU combinations are anatomically impossible (e.g., full AU1+AU4 simultaneous activation is constrained), while others co-occur in specific emotional expressions. The method flags anatomically invalid AU combinations produced by deepfake generators.

3. **Emotional Expression Coherencia**: Detected AU combinations are mapped to basic emotions (happiness:AU6+12, sadness:AU1+4+15, anger:AU4+5+7+23, etc.) and verified for emotional coherence. The method checks whether the expression is a valid emotional state and whether expression transitions follow logical emotional progression. Deepfakes may produce incoherent or emotionally impossible AU patterns.

4. **AU Intensity Dynamics**: AU intensity changes follow neuromuscular dynamics — smooth onset, peak, and offset with physiologically constrained velocities. The method analyzes intensity dynamics of each active AU. Deepfakes may show unnatural intensity profiles: stepped changes, too-fast transitions, or perfectly linear ramps instead of natural muscle contraction curves.

5. **FACS - Habla Coordination**: During speech, specific AU patterns correlate with phoneme articulation (AU25/26/27 for jaw opening, AU22/28 for lip pucker). The method verifies FACS-speech temporal coordination. Deepfakes may show misaligned lip-jaw AU patterns relative to the audio speech signal.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
